title: Florida House, District 24
what_it_does: Represents District 24 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Decided Aug. 18, 2026: incumbent Republican Ryan Chamberlin won the universal primary (open to all voters because only Republicans qualified) with about 62% over Scott Wilkins.
verified_ballot_note: ClickOrlando's voter guide identifies HD 24 as a universal primary between Ryan Chamberlin and Scott Wilkins (https://www.clickorlando.com/voters-guide/2026/07/31/2026-voters-guide-florida-house-district-24-universal-primary/); Central Florida Public Media and 352today reported Chamberlin won outright with about 62% (https://www.cfpublic.org/live-updates/live-updates-primary-election-day-in-central-florida). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Ryan Chamberlin
candidates.photo_source: Florida House member page (MemberId=4901); image URL not verified
candidates.background: Incumbent Republican state representative for HD 24 (rural Marion County around Ocala), first elected in a 2023 special election. Won the Aug. 18, 2026 universal primary with about 62% over Scott Wilkins, which decided the seat.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug. 18, 2026 universal primary with ~62% over Scott Wilkins
